**今日经济头条：中东炮火重燃引爆全球风险资产抛售，科技股与油价冰火两重天**

过去24小时，伊朗与以色列互射导弹令中东停火协议摇摇欲坠，油价应声飙升超3%，同时美国超预期就业数据强化了加息预期，双重打击下全球科技股遭遇“黑色星期一”。韩国Kospi开盘暴跌超8%，日韩台及港股AI概念集体溃退，领跌的正是此前领涨的明星板块。欧洲央行本周面临“滞胀”抉择，市场押注其可能加息。中国市场方面，A股科创50狂泻3.63%，但煤炭、光纤等传统板块逆势走强，南向资金继续大举买入港股50亿港元。美债收益率攀升与地缘风险交织，投资者正重新校准“通胀-增长”天平。

- **[伊朗与以色列交火，中东停火濒临破裂](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/iran-fires-missiles-israel-ceasefire-strains.html)**：两国相互打击威胁到自4月初以来美国斡旋的脆弱停火协议，霍尔木兹海峡实质关闭令全球原油供应受困。
- **[油价飙涨3%，OPEC+象征性增产188,000桶/日](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/oil-prices-today-us-iran-missile-middle-east-israel-opec.html)**：增产力度远不足以弥补海峡断流造成的缺口，能源股与航空股走势截然分化。
- **[亚洲科技股崩跌，SoftBank跌超7%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/softbank-samsung-tech-ai-stocks-asia-fall.html)**：隔夜美国Broadcom等AI明星股惨遭抛售，亚洲市场跟跌，投资者对AI“烧钱换增长”模式的信心动摇。
- **[外资今年已抛售数十亿美元韩国股票](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/kospi-sk-hynix-samsung-electronics-why-foreign-investors-are-selling.html)**：尽管韩国Kospi此前是今年全球表现最佳的市场之一，但外资正加速撤离，周一单日暴跌8%加剧恐慌。
- **[香港IPO市场出现“破发”问题](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/hong-kongs-ipo-boom-is-developing-a-performance-problem.html)**：香港与华尔街争夺全球IPO桂冠时，越来越多新股上市后跌穿发行价，大金重工IPO筹资66.4亿港元成今日焦点。
- **[A股科创板重挫3.63%，仅5只成分股上涨](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1wT0lvWVRlX0w0dWVmMmhVekl6ajlodEVSTGxrZEF4d2RpWlIzTW9nYVVrVEF2amRjR3VaczA4VFdrZ1VFcGhBWWEtVDBHbFhVaG9DRlhZcWFkdzR5dkE)**：贵金属、半导体、铜缆高速连接板块跌幅居前，而煤炭开采、光纤“三剑客”逆势走强。

**后续观察**：中东局势若持续恶化，油价可能突破前高并推升全球通胀，迫使更多央行加息。本周美国CPI数据和欧洲央行利率决议将成为市场信心测试的关键变量。AI板块的深度回调是否意味着“AI泡沫”第一次真正破裂，还需关注未来几日资金流向。中国方面，监管层强调“非法”对外投资整顿不会强制平仓，但资本外流压力尚未缓解。
economy.en:
The global financial landscape is gripped by a confluence of geopolitical shockwaves and monetary policy recalibration. Iran and Israel exchanged strikes, sending oil prices surging over 3% and triggering a broad risk-off tone across Asian and US equity markets. Tech stocks, particularly AI-related names, suffered sharp sell-offs as investors reassess valuation amid rising rate expectations. In China, markets slumped on fears of capital outflows following a strong US jobs report, while European markets brace for a potential ECB rate hike. The outlook is dominated by the interplay between inflation, geopolitical instability, and the unwinding of the AI rally.

- **Iran-Israel strikes escalate**: Oil spikes >3%, Kospi plunges 8%, global risk aversion. [CNBC Iran-Israel](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/iran-fires-missiles-israel-ceasefire-strains.html), [CNBC oil](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/oil-prices-today-us-iran-missile-middle-east-israel-opec.html), [BBC Asia tech](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78yd5g9qx0o)
- **AI trade unwinds**: SoftBank down 7%, Broadcom-led sell-off, Asian tech extends losses. Hyperscalers now epicenter of bear case. [CNBC Asia tech](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/softbank-samsung-tech-ai-stocks-asia-fall.html), [Cramer hyperscalers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html)
- **US rate increase fears**: Blowout jobs data fuels bets on Fed tightening, impacting emerging markets and Hong Kong stocks. [SCMP HK slump](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356289/hong-kong-stocks-slumped-ai-rallies-asia-unwind-us-rate-increase-anxiety), [Devdiscourse China market drop](https://news.google.)
- **China market rout**: A-share Sci-Tech 50 down 3.63%, only 5 stocks up. Hang Seng down 0.7%, tech index down 1.6%. [同花顺午评](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1wT0lvWVRlX0w0dWVmMmhVekl6ajlodEVSTGxrZEF4d2RpWlIzTW9nYVVrVEF2amRjR3VaczA4VFdrZ1VFcGhBWWEtVDBHbFhVaG9DRlhZcWFkdzR5dkE), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356289/hong-kong-stocks-slumped-ai-rallies-asia-unwind-us-rate-increase-anxiety)
- **ECB poised to hike**: First rate rise in two years amid stagflation dilemma; some asset managers see 'one and done'. [EUobserver](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNWnhoamZGRXdVbkhFNi1oQk91dEJXZjVwMk1WcjBoaDV5aG9kWUQyQ2xRb2lkYVhWX1NvVHFyRk5veDc3VlBIVmhWRzdHZmo5NkpkV0tpRXRlSmVYYVozaGFxQ0dfSktSeFYtY3M0eV9LSk1VOV91TFhUemJvdFZqUk13RFpPQzFmT05haVhhQ1o2Q2laMmI1TERsMjVvM21seEMyTnVodDdEUVl6MkY2cUh3X2xxMEhW), [Capital Brief](https://news.google.), [Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOc0RxNnZBVlJjckdRR0VaOGgzdXBvTjEtbFM5OVI4REdXQ2VpbHNaMEtwOVN3aG9pd3FPS2pPa3BockxiZFlMQjNiT0ZyclAzVXdjYllza3Uxa0ZkNm85ZkdjSzNKejFqa2lxd0haSTRrRHZDWGs4TXNsRzhKeHE0a3dvWDVKWGV3VGM5QWdZblhXWlJYdWdGaWNBTVBzVlRFcnY2MHROamdfM2JoMEdaRA)
- **OPEC+ to boost oil production** despite Strait of Hormuz shutdown – largely symbolic move. [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/07/business/opec-oil-production-iran-war.html)
- **Hong Kong IPO boom faces performance problem**; Dajin Heavy Industry debuts at HKD6.64bn. [CNBC HK IPO](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/hong-kongs-ipo-boom-is-developing-a-performance-problem.html), [Law.asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBaMEtTSXBPaThXNU5OWE11U1Y1SGhHZk9DM1JBV29Xc3pIRl9NTkxDdzRvc21RQVl2Nk02cHRnTWZBdE1idEFWejUwOGQ1bWxfN1lQMnZyREVfeWlzc0E)
- **European telecom consolidation begins** with SFR acquisition. [Le Monde](https://news.google.)

**Watch next**: Investors will focus on US CPI data and the ECB rate decision this week, while monitoring further developments in the Middle East. The unwinding of AI momentum could accelerate if hyperscaler capex disappoints. In China, regulatory signals on outbound investment will be key.

society.zh:
**导语：** 中东战火重燃，以色列与伊朗互射导弹打破停火脆弱平衡，全球市场应声下跌；欧洲为乌克兰和平条件设限，而特朗普将注意力转向伊朗。日韩股市受挫，但韩国在冲突与AI竞赛中逆势繁荣；中国进入高考季，教育部启动就业冲刺，AI育儿争议引发讨论。知乎财报亮眼，AI成为商业化新引擎。

- **中东危局升级：** 以色列与伊朗在停火数周后再度交火，[以色列袭击德黑兰、伊斯法罕](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/8/iran-war-live-trump-urges-restraint-after-iranian-missile-attack-on-israel?traffic_source=rss)，伊朗则以导弹回击。卫星图像显示[美以战争对伊朗造成的破坏](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/6/8/satellite-images-show-destruction-of-the-us-israel-war-on-iran?traffic_source=rss)，冲突有蔓延至黎巴嫩之势。
- **全球市场震荡：** 受中东局势与美联储加息预期冲击，[亚洲股市大幅下跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxNSUhBcW91REdSYm56V2owN3BmNUNKODBtWVZfVUJUQUw2dmo5bnJ4S0xKOHBIcmhSSG5kdF85X3V6TEVUNHo2Yzg1SlBDSThNMlNuX1VwV05xNjhfVmg5ZlRiczFRVC1pSktrY19iRjd5UGh0QmxvNXNmRjZtNzJtVmU0c0ZxWDFHQzNlNlZJb1RRSG5SbWUxRVhXa0N1SGkxdl9lSi1TYmRGRTU0RGk1UGRtem00aG1idHNJU3ZYb0M)，韩国和日本领跌。
- **乌克兰和平僵局：** 泽连斯基欧洲盟友提出[五项和平条件](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7xr1g3nvvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，但特朗普政府重心转向伊朗，和平进程前景黯淡。
- **世界杯隐忧：** 美国旅行禁令和签证限制引发全球球迷愤怒，[“这是他们的世界杯，不是我们的”](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx212p8r28eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)成为社交媒体热词。
- **韩国选举争议：** 因选票短缺，[韩国年轻人要求重新选举](https://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20260607062542)，代理总统李洛渊公开道歉。
- **中国高考与就业：** 全国高考首日，[教育部长亲赴北京调度](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE43RklJV1dOcnRPMldyZk83OUhLeWVFWGgtVTVhLXJuVnkxbG5TU0xYUHdRb2hMVHVwMnRmbHJFQURZLW5TbUhvRkVRYzl1blU2VmxVeXhvVTYxU0NNLURyanBtVVA1azVMNHc)，多地推迟上班保障通行；同时教育部启动[“百日冲刺”促就业](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQSmRlWV9HeEtmS1FkOGhHWU5XRmhfM05icUVoZVlCVVBYX2xrR1B4V0FGejNNYkd1LW5Qd3lUM0UwVFJobHJQRDR1MXBoY1Q3V1JISjg0QTlRTzAydllJZXRWNkhSME5BMHVQY2Y2WHFYWktSSzFjaEl4dVZnbkg0UGROelV2QWhfOXI0R0pnSGZ6aVV2VXhuZg)。
- **知乎财报双面：** Q1净利润同比增147%，但[全年营收下滑23.6%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)，CEO周源押注AI商业化。

**后续观察：** 中东冲突走向是下周最大变量——若美伊全面开战，油价与全球供应链将受重创；日韩股市短期承压，但韩国军工与半导体或成赢家。中国高考季与就业压力交织，AI对教育伦理的冲击需持续关注。知乎能否借AI扭转营收下滑趋势，值得财报季跟踪。

The past 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in the Middle East, with Israel and Iran trading direct strikes that threaten to shatter the fragile ceasefire. This geopolitical shockwave is already rattling global markets, especially in Asia, while domestic Chinese news focuses on the annual college entrance exam (Gaokao) and policy efforts to boost youth employment. Meanwhile, Japan and South Korea show signs of cautious rapprochement, and Zhihu posts a strong quarterly earnings surprise.

- **Middle East conflict spirals**: Israel launched strikes on Tehran and Isfahan after Iran fired a missile at Israel for the first time since the April ceasefire. Hezbollah also resumed attacks, drawing Israeli retaliation on Beirut suburbs. The US-Israel war on Iran has caused widespread destruction, visible in satellite images ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/6/8/satellite-images-show-destruction-of-the-us-israel-war-on-iran?traffic_source=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/08/g-s1-126844/iran-war-updates)). 
- **Global markets under pressure**: Asian shares plunged as Big Tech selloffs in Wall Street combined with Middle East uncertainty to create the worst day in months for stocks. South Korea and Japan indices were hit hard ([WRAL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxNSUhBcW91REdSYm56V2owN3BmNUNKODBtWVZfVUJUQUw2dmo5bnJ4S0xKOHBIcmhSSG5kdF85X3V6TEVUNHo2Yzg1SlBDSThNMlNuX1VwV05xNjhfVmg5ZlRiczFRVC1pSktrY19iRjd5UGh0QmxvNXNmRjZtNzJtVmU0c0ZxWDFHQzNlNlZJb1RRSG5SbWUxRVhXa0N1SGkxdl9lSi1TYmRGRTU0RGk1UGRtem00aG1idHNJU3ZYb0M), [Nikkei Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNOTlsZVFldTh1XzR3WHh2bXFHTFRqcUNGVjlya2IzTkczMTgzQjZjN2ZPM1ZNLUV6RU40ZGRKMEdXZ3J6ZmJOVGlzUmt3ZzB3M3k3TWRMYWhEMGM0Uk9waDFlaVRQS2ZQYW9YTE1MY2IwcEg3YkR1cHRfXy1oUWMtcEhvTFplRjkxdkNVbFduVjV0QjVMLTBLYzhSVHlNckNad0V2VnY4aWhNdzZIbzhEQnExTHVzUQ)). 
- **Zelensky's European allies lay peace conditions**: As Trump's focus shifts to Iran, Ukraine’s closest European backers set five conditions for any peace talks with Russia, signaling a potential shift in Western strategy ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7xr1g3nvvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)). 
- **China prioritizes Gaokao and youth employment**: Education Minister personally supervised the national college entrance exam, with many cities delaying work hours to ease traffic. Meanwhile, the Ministry launched a '100-day sprint' to boost 2026 graduate employment ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQSmRlWV9HeEtmS1FkOGhHWU5XRmhfM05icUVoZVlCVVBYX2xrR1B4V0FGejNNYkd1LW5Qd3lUM0UwVFJobHJQRDR1MXBoY1Q3V1JISjg0QTlRTzAydllJZXRWNkhSME5BMHVQY2Y2WHFYWktSSzFjaEl4dVZnbkg0UGROelV2QWhfOXI0R0pnSGZ6aVV2VXhuZg), [Lianhe Zaobao](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE43RklJV1dOcnRPMldyZk83OUhLeWVFWGgtVTVhLXJuVnkxbG5TU0xYUHdRb2hMVHVwMnRmbHJFQURZLW5TbUhvRkVRYzl1blU2VmxVeXhvVTYxU0NNLURyanBtVVA1azVMNHc)). 
- **Japan and South Korea inch closer**: The two countries held their first joint search-and-rescue drill in 9 years, and Japan is seeking talks to lift the seafood import ban related to Fukushima ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1GRkdvRUdWSlhpMFVEcWktb3lPRHZjaHhzbjc3cndadUtLT0Q0cUFvTFZlTGlZVkhfY2hSUzBveEEwMG5wbHhpSE14bXBuNlUyOEw5azhMaS16SVHSAVdBVV95cUxPSGs3ckhxUmJtSHBYS3FUTkJ4R0g0c0p5SlNJUFhIMEpvRHlacjVuLURRUUM0QXpwSm9CeDZjdEZFUHFTUG9FZnp1TUZNNHVRRkJfVnNKYUU)). 
- **Zhihu earnings beat expectations**: The Q1 2026 net profit surged 147% year-on-year to ¥17.16 million as the Q&A platform accelerates AI commercialization. The stock also saw a share buyback ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxObTBETGowRFVFOFE4UUl2UWVzY0pRdlZocFMzc2h0aGp0YlV3VWxNejlsYUFvQ1ZKOXVjNGZQ2Y2dzkwV3o1elkzbjdrUkZtcHVKd0xhOHBvZl9kNFZ6Y1JEZGhhM3hzc1Y4V2FfWHJ0eVpEU0xrM2Mxa0J4MzAxMDR2dWc1d2tBclAtVg)). 

**Watch next**: The Iran-Israel military exchange remains highly fluid; any further escalation could trigger a broader regional war and deeper market selloffs. Markets will also watch for US Federal Reserve signals after the rate-hike fears that hit Asia. In China, Gaokao continues, and the '100-day sprint' for graduate employment may offer policy clues. The US World Cup travel bans could become a wider diplomatic flashpoint.

military.zh:
今日全球军事焦点骤然转向中东：伊朗于6月8日凌晨向以色列发射弹道导弹，这是自今年4月停火以来的首次直接攻击，作为对以色列轰炸贝鲁特的回应。美国随即打击伊朗沿海雷达站，并击落伊朗无人机，同时波斯湾和印度洋方向出现伊朗警告性导弹和无人机逼近美军舰只的事件，能源与加密货币市场出现波动。与此同时，乌克兰战场继续大规模无人机交锋，俄方声称13小时内拦截339架乌无人机。印太方向，日本首相高市早苗明确“台海有事时”营救日美公民的表态，与越南在南海加速填海造岛、菲律宾在Balikatan演习中接收美军NMESIS反舰系统等事件叠加，令中国周边安全压力上升。以下是今日重点情报综述：

- **[Iran Launches Ballistic Missile Attacks On Israel](https://www.twz.com/news-features/iran-launches-ballistic-missile-attacks-on-israel)** — 伊朗向以色列发射多枚弹道导弹，以色列北部拦截画面被证实。这是德黑兰在停火两个月后再次选择直接军事对抗。
- **[US strikes Iranian sites after Iran launches drones](https://www.defensenews.com/flashpoints/middle-east/2026/06/06/us-strikes-iranian-sites-after-iran-launches-drones-in-latest-gulf-flare-up/)** — 美军打击伊朗海岸雷达站并击落其无人机，冲突从以色列-伊朗直接对抗扩展至美伊直接交锋。
- **[Iran fires warning missiles and drones at US warships in Gulf of Oman](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5XeUI2UVEzRTZtVmZDbzZOdG01QWFRcGU2R1BaNUFPZVBwZ29iR05FbmFjRUhpR2Z1VzdGa295dXJoLTN5SGIyVk5CeS16UURuVzNqNWpxbGdqcEZqckFDMmR3SnBRU3VnRDM5WVlNZ1ZsUWtTamQ1S1d3)** — 伊朗在阿曼湾向美军舰发射警告性导弹和无人机，霍尔木兹海峡航道安全风险陡增。
- **[Ukraine war briefing: Kyiv unleashes hundreds of drones on Russia](https://news.google.)** — 乌克兰在普京拒绝与泽连斯基会面后发动大规模无人机攻势，俄方称拦截339架。
- **[China could soon upgrade aircraft carriers amid Japan’s military buildup](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQVW1ZUHhIM1dGV0I4VVhUc3FFajg2Y2E2Q2x3dUw4aExmVDR6RDF6ZXg3Qkh4Yjd0cFFKNUFLUnRoZWFpQlEza1RMUW93T242cDNVZzRvempfMV95dWFsTUh0SUtKYzJUQ09Wb1hlNU9VVWt0NUptSDdocFVRd0o5ZU5YWjlEODdzYjVQdEgxQzZuYWZm)** — 面对日本增强打击能力，中国国内舆论敦促加快航母舰队升级。
- **[Ksliu：越南发起填海造岛“雷霆攻势”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFB6TDl0a21YMTUxR3hfTWpHMTEyUFBOdk44RTRucXBtUWF2TmxTTkd1bFZ1WWRoTkVVRnRqaUFWTHdBdTlKd3M2ano1S0dsR3NYWTdSVlc0cWlvbTFHZjhLd3FLLW4tbkQzMHc)** — 越南在南海加速填海造岛，中方反应强烈，南海平衡出现微妙变化。
- **[Turkish Navy Confirms 2032 Delivery Date for MUGEM Aircraft Carrier](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/turkish-navy-confirms-2032-delivery-date-for-mugem-aircraft-carrier/)** — 土耳其海军公布国产航母MUGEM 2032年服役，全球海军扩军竞争再添新变量。

**后续观察：** 伊朗-以色列-美国三方冲突短期内看不到降温信号，霍尔木兹海峡的军事化倾向将直接影响全球能源供应和航运保险成本。乌克兰无人机战常态化表明战场消耗战加剧。印太方向，日本与菲律宾的激进姿态与美国在地区的新装备部署（NMESIS、HIMARS反舰）可能迫使中国在航母和反介入能力上加快动作。建议持续跟踪伊朗报复升级的波及范围（如红海、波斯湾），以及中国是否会启动新一轮航母建造或南海实控行动。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a dramatic escalation in the Middle East, with Iran launching ballistic missiles at Israel for the first time since the April ceasefire, triggering Israeli retaliatory strikes and a US military response against Iranian coastal radar sites. Meanwhile, the Ukraine conflict sees a massive Ukrainian drone offensive against Russia, and the Indo-Pacific theater is marked by Chinese carrier fleet upgrade pressures, new anti-ship weapons tested in the Philippines, and continued US interdiction of Iranian-linked shipping. Here are the key developments:

- Iran launched a ballistic missile attack on Israel on June 7-8, breaking the ceasefire in place since April. Interceptions were reported over northern Israel, and Israel subsequently struck Iranian military targets. ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/iran-launches-ballistic-missile-attacks-on-israel), [JNS.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9ha2o5dXJoSGllQjRERmpVN09ESHotU3pldnNrYTJNcHpNWEx0c2RDT1VXSXJGM0pqZnlNTTlDSlBJWUlOTkpBTW1sY3o2WkhrMmFVSm8xSW9qZVZiTlY1NjkxeWFSS2hTMVZn))
- The United States struck Iranian coastal radar sites on June 6 after Iran launched drones toward the Strait of Hormuz, while US forces interdicted a stateless vessel linked to Iran in the Indian Ocean. ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/flashpoints/middle-east/2026/06/06/us-strikes-iranian-sites-after-iran-launches-drones-in-latest-gulf-flare-up/), [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/05/u-s-forces-interdict-ship-connected-to-iran-in-indian-ocean-iranian-oil-exports-see-decrease))
- Ukraine launched hundreds of drones at Russia after President Putin rejected a meeting with Zelenskyy; Russia claimed to have intercepted 339 drones in a 13-hour period. ([The Guardian](https://news.google.), [MSN](https://news.google.))
- China is being urged to accelerate carrier fleet upgrades as Japan enhances its strike capabilities, with deployments of HQ-16F missiles near Taiwan and ongoing tensions in the South China Sea. ([South China Morning Post](https://news.google.), [Interesting Engineering](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQVW1ZUHhIM1dGV0I4VVhUc3FFajg2Y2E2Q2x3dUw4aExmVDR6RDF6ZXg3Qkh4Yjd0cFFKNUFLUnRoZWFpQlEza1RMUW93T242cDNVZzRvempfMV95dWFsTUh0SUtKYzJUQ09Wb1hlNU9VVWt0NUptSDdocFVRd0o5ZU5YWjlEODdzYjVQdEgxQzZuYWZm))
- In the Indo-Pacific, the US Marine Corps tested the NMESIS anti-ship system during Exercise Balikatan in the Philippines, while Turkey confirmed a 2032 delivery date for its MUGEM aircraft carrier. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/the-philippines-meets-its-nmesis-in-balikatan-exercise/), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/turkish-navy-confirms-2032-delivery-date-for-mugem-aircraft-carrier/))
- Economic ripples: Iran's warning missiles and drones at US warships in the Gulf of Oman rattled energy and crypto markets, while the G7 signaled readiness to use strategic reserves to stabilize energy markets. ([Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5XeUI2UVEzRTZtVmZDbzZOdG01QWFRcGU2R1BaNUFPZVBwZ29iR05FbmFjRUhpR2Z1VzdGa295dXJoLTN5SGIyVk5CeS16UURuVzNqNWpxbGdqcEZqckFDMmR3SnBRU3VnRDM5WVlNZ1ZsUWtTamQ1S1d3), [财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE40cm9xSmNGd1hFbHd6b3ZiYXVaZzFVRkRMYTJzOUw3Q2xpblF6TmEtQ2lDRDk3ZTc0bXphcm8yZDZHdHcwTnYydg))

**Watch next:** The Iran-Israel retaliation cycle could escalate further, with potential spillover into the Strait of Hormuz and global energy markets. China's response to Japan's military buildup and its own carrier modernization timeline will be critical for regional stability. The Ukraine drone war shows no sign of abating, and the US role in the Middle East remains a wild card.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现出「游戏大展」与「AI攻防」双主线。Xbox Games Showcase 2026 以《战争机器：E-Day》独占、透明绿25周年纪念主机、Fable定档等消息宣告硬件独占策略回归；与此同时，AI领域迎来安全新阶段——OpenAI 推出防提示注入的封锁模式、DeepSeek V4 Pro在精度上超越 GPT-5.5 Pro，而学术与社区则忧虑算法招聘、多巴胺劫持等深层问题。以下为关键动态：

- **Xbox 独占收紧**：《战争机器：E-Day》确认不登陆 PS5，微软在 Showcase 上明确「回归 Xbox」信号，与早前多平台策略形成反差。同步发布的透明绿25周年纪念主机向初代致敬，Fable 定档2027年2月23日。 [详情](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/945269/gears-of-war-e-day-ps5-launch)
- **OpenAI 推出「封锁模式」**：针对提示注入攻击推出专门防御层，与 Anthropic、Google 联合签署防止 AI 制造生物武器的公开信。 [报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1LUi00LW91X21WY014QXpoVWN3ZWpXdDRNZ2JYWHA1VzVJbDdpTHZMUnNoM2NucmJ4ckgtM1R1VXJRYl9wQVNGT01OUU9XeXhDLW5TS2VBSVdOVGUzclg3b1ctR204bmNBT1B4Vm5XMWx5WDV6RDJlejRR)
- **DeepSeek V4 Pro 精度反超**：据社区测试，DeepSeek V4 Pro 在 precision 指标上击败 GPT-5.5 Pro，Hacker News 获 171 点赞、52 条讨论，反映出中国开源模型的竞争力。 [链接](https://runtimewire.com/article/deepseek-v4-pro-beats-gpt-5-5-pro-on-precision)
- **丰田拟推模拟手动变速箱**：或超越现代已有的模拟换挡技术，体现电动化时代保留驾驶乐趣的差异化尝试。 [来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOb2VfcjF4c1p4T3N2czVNSU1pb0w4NDd1aC14MHNtbHIxOEZHYkhXNWFOSGJrTXg2UTNoVktrUnkwYkQwbnNzTHVLN2poZ2M2NUpxbVZ3ZEZwbUVLQzBWZGZ0Sm1HdTV6REZnRHd4ZVhfeWxmR3VvV0ZCNHk5amZySGpFSFVINEZxWEgyeEZaaENYS3h6T2V4a1otcVJZVy00WTFrUWZBYVlNdw)
- **德州电网警报**：数据中心和加密货币矿场未能通过电压测试，引发对可再生能源+高耗能负载的稳定性担忧，Hacker News 53 点讨论。 [报道](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/texas-grid-flags-risks-data-centers-crypto-sites-fail-voltage-tests-2026-06-05/)
- **新药「功能性治愈」乙肝**：Science 报道一种药物对多数乙肝病毒感染实现功能治愈，Hacker News 获 108 点赞，为生物医药重大突破。 [文章](https://www.science.org/content/article/new-drug-functionally-cures-many-hepatitis-b-virus-infections?user_id=66c4bf745d78644b3aa57b08)
- **Prada 联手 Axiom Space 推出登月内衣**：NASA 为 Artemis IV 任务展示 Prada 设计的液冷通风内衣 LCVG，时尚与太空科技再次跨界。 [详情](https://www.theverge.com/design/945540/nasa-axiom-space-prada-lcvg-spacesuit-moon-artemis)

**后续观察**：微软独占策略逆转是否会引发索尼反制？DeepSeek 精度反超是否意味着 GPT 系列护城河松动？AI 生物武器共识虽签，但执行机制存疑。今晚的 Summer Game Fest 后，游戏硬件路线图（Switch 2 应对）与 AI 安全政策动向值得持续追踪。
tech.en:
Today's tech news was dominated by major gaming announcements from Summer Game Fest and Xbox, a wave of AI security and governance developments, and a surprising AI model benchmark upset. Highlights include Microsoft's exclusivity reversal with Gears of War, OpenAI's lockdown mode against prompt injection, and DeepSeek's V4 Pro outperforming GPT-5.5 on precision.

- [Gears of War: E-Day isn’t coming to the PS5](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/945269/gears-of-war-e-day-ps5-launch) – Microsoft reversed earlier multi-platform rumors, making the new Gears an Xbox console exclusive, signaling a retreat from PlayStation releases.
- [Halo: Campaign Evolved arrives July 28th](https://www.theverge.com/games/939564/halo-campaign-evolved-xbox-games-showcase-2026) – The Halo: Combat Evolved campaign remake will launch on Xbox, PC, and (notably) PS5, a rare cross-platform move for a flagship title.
- [Fable launches in late February after recent delay](https://www.theverge.com/games/939536/fable-xbox-games-showcase-2026) – Microsoft confirmed a February 23, 2027 release date after pushing the reboot out of 2026.
- [Persona 6 exists, and that’s all we know](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/945256/persona-6-teaser) – Atlus teased the long-awaited sequel at Summer Game Fest, but gave no release window.
- [DeepSeek V4 Pro beats GPT-5.5 Pro on precision](https://runtimewire.com/article/deepseek-v4-pro-beats-gpt-5-5-pro-on-precision) – A Chinese AI model reportedly outscored OpenAI's latest on precision benchmarks, sparking intense debate on Hacker News (171 points, 52 comments).
- [OpenAI Launches Lockdown Mode To Block Prompt Injection Attacks](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1LUi00LW91X21WY014QXpoVWN3ZWpXdDRNZ2JYWHA1VzVJbDdpTHZMUnNoM2NucmJ4ckgtM1R1VXJRYl9wQVNGT01OUU9XeXhDLW5TS2VBSVdOVGUzclg3b1ctR204bmNBT1B4Vm5XMWx5WDV6RDJlejRR) – A new security feature aims to thwart adversarial prompts, a key concern as AI agents proliferate.
- [SDSU Wired Its Dorms with 1,300 AI Cameras Without Telling Students](https://reclaimthenet.org/sdsu-adds-1300-ai-cameras-330-in-student-dorms) – A privacy controversy emerges as San Diego State University installed surveillance systems in dormitories, drawing criticism from student advocates.

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on further reactions to DeepSeek's benchmark results, the fallout from Microsoft's exclusivity decisions, and the evolving AI regulatory landscape as companies sign bioweapons pledges.

sports.zh:
今日体育版图风云涌动：从丹麦赛场埃里克森惊魂一刻，到罗兰加洛斯兹维列夫四年轮回终夺冠；从F1摩纳哥站汉密尔顿再登领奖台，到羽毛球加拿大新星赖浩俊印尼赛登顶——竞技体育的戏剧性与不确定性在24小时内集中爆发。以下为关键看点。

- **[Christian Eriksen conscious after collapsing during Denmark friendly](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13551756/christian-eriksen-denmark-friendly-with-ukraine-abandoned-after-midfielder-collapses-on-pitch)**：丹麦中场在友谊赛中倒地，所幸恢复意识，这一幕让人想起2021年欧洲杯的惊悚瞬间，球员心脏健康问题再度成为焦点。
- **[Zverev triumphs at last at French Open](https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/c1ky3ddv1vzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)**：四年前坐着轮椅离场的兹维列夫，如今以罗兰加洛斯冠军身份告别，意志力的胜利完美诠释体育精神。
- **[Hamilton thankful for Kardashian support at Monaco GP](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13551588/lewis-hamilton-ferrari-driver-thankful-for-amazing-kim-kardashian-support-at-monaco-gp-after-latest-f1-podium)**：汉密尔顿在法拉利复苏中再获第二，赛后感慨“需要提醒人们我是谁”，F1圈内外话题不断。
- **[Hodgkinson stunned by Werro despite personal best](https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/articles/cly8l037pp9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)**：奥运冠军霍奇金森跑出PB仍不敌瑞士新星Werro，女子800米格局正在重塑。

sports.en:
The past 24 hours delivered a mix of drama and milestones across the sports world. Denmark midfielder Christian Eriksen collapsed on the pitch but was conscious shortly after, renewing concerns about player safety just weeks before the World Cup. In tennis, Alexander Zverev completed a remarkable comeback by winning the French Open, while in badminton, Canada's Lai Haojun stunned the field to win the Indonesia Open Super 1000. The NBA off-season saw speculation about a potential CBA champion participation in the NBA Cup, and the Western Conference's top four teams posted an extraordinary 35-5 run in their last 40 games. Here are the key developments:

- **[Christian Eriksen collapses during Denmark friendly, conscious](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13551756/christian-eriksen-denmark-friendly-with-ukraine-abandoned-after-midfielder-collapses-on-pitch)** – The match was abandoned after Eriksen fell to the ground in the first half. He was treated on the pitch and later reported conscious in hospital. The incident echoes his cardiac arrest at Euro 2020 and raises immediate questions about his and the team's World Cup participation.
- **[Zverev triumphs at French Open four years after wheelchair exit](https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/c1ky3ddv1vzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** – Alexander Zverev defeated Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set thriller to claim his first Grand Slam title. His dramatic 2022 semi-final, where he tore ankle ligaments and left Roland Garros in a wheelchair, makes this victory one of the most emotional in recent tennis history.
- **[Lai Haojun wins first Super 1000 title at Indonesia Open](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxQN3JvMGlqV3Z3N3VXVEdvZHlnS1NVXzZkMy0zTzlwQmVKc251YVVpRmhSTDVXV2RBclFKUXp3RFI2eDk2eDd1cVE1MkhoMUFuSUkySDBOaGRpY3EzckJMQUd6emFSN010WFJfN3JLdUhIUlNpSjdZMjdxblY4TldlNTNORU84RkU)** – The Canadian shuttler defeated world No. 1 Shi Yuqi in the final, marking a major shift in men's singles power dynamics. China's national team was shut out of titles in Indonesia for the first time in months.
- **[Feyenoord sack manager Robin van Persie](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNeTloX1NlNmtwV3FvdUowT3E4eG9oekd5OG93cHFJazduSUpKMFZScnBrckxPblZrWXpELXJEUVlYekRoeW5VNmZxQWltajJOb3FaLTFkNGNhdkFacGFPTHhudUZzN19SWkNGR1diVHdhd19OY2VueWlRVzJpbGRhTjdJN09hbVJQVW1YeWFnZ19Gb3NnSG1z)** – The Eredivisie club terminated Van Persie's contract after a disappointing season. The Dutch legend had only taken charge last summer, and his dismissal signals a turbulent rebuild ahead.
- **[CBA champions participating in NBA Cup proposed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE96VGdjc1IzZDQ2OGVtQzBCVkxmR3JEaDQ4Z3E0SlFYUUJwSVdpQnAwYUd3RE84YWgwcWstM04zYXNzSmtEcWh6anlCeVJUeUswSkhoV3luRGtwbHdnWnJoVGJyalJwZFZmdmwzU1M3YmItNWtfNkZJ)** – A speculative article discusses the potential positive impacts on Chinese basketball if the CBA champion were invited to the NBA Cup. While unconfirmed, it has sparked debate about cross-league competition and player development.
- **Western Conference arms race: top 4 teams go 35-5 in last 40 games** – The Thunder, Spurs, Lakers, and Nuggets have set a blistering pace, with the Lakers and Nuggets both on long winning streaks. This unprecedented consistency could redefine playoff seeding expectations.

**Watch next:** All eyes on Eriksen's health update and whether Denmark will proceed with World Cup preparations. In tennis, the grass-court season begins immediately, while badminton's World Championships are just weeks away. The NBA draft combine also enters its final phase, with potential trades reshaping the league's landscape.

- [中國經濟下行「中產破產七件套」成網絡熱詞](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE56cjRwWDdmaHJkSnFpT1RQYWdMNmtqRjZEYjcwN1VWVDYyMDJEUEViS2ZTaWxaazMxMzVDSl9IRmlUVUpSXzBvSUVKN3ZELW1ieVVPMnd5cUYyd19RODFJ0gFkQVVfeXFMUGVFdjI5TndWLUgzQ2hyLXRic2x6R0lGcnhtazBvOTUyTlpFbno1Mk5PWVFwdU9tTGRpdDFqSHJlaXdtNFhrNXFBcy1WOG4xTHZMamJNdGZNcFVuTWh1QnluV0lOYw) — “中产破产七件套”成为微博热词。
- [中國桐庐·富春江影视科技产教示范区AIGC高科技影视创制中心正式启航](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFB2a20temRMUWtHaFNjaU8xY3NKQWNqRzNleXl6RmZ2Q0VzWkVkaTVnR3Y5d2R2TFBWQ3l0VmJkTmhHN1JTaVhRRHF4TmJkYkR1QmZIRU1DUkwxaXNRcGpicE5oTk45VWltWmRfeGNJcy0zV01ueDZtaTV5TQ) — 浙江布局AIGC影视产业新高地。
- [Scott Rudin Wins Tony Award After Leaving Industry Due to Bullying Claims](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/arts/scott-rudin-wins-best-play-tony-awards-bullying-claims-1236616126/) — 鲁丁获奖但未到场，引发争议。

entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape over the past 24 hours has been dominated by two major themes: the 79th Tony Awards in the US, which delivered historic wins, political statements, and a major milestone for Apple TV+, and a surge in Chinese industry activity around AIGC (AI-generated content) in film and TV production. Meanwhile, Korean pop culture continues its cross-border momentum with new drama teasers, a long-awaited girl group comeback, and a Hollywood crossover, while Chinese social media buzzes with celebrity disputes, sports crossovers, and viral social commentary.

- **Tony Awards sweep with historic firsts**: The 79th Tony Awards saw *Schmigadoon!* win Best Musical, earning Apple TV+ its EGOT, while John Lithgow became the oldest male acting winner at 80. *Liberation* won Best Play, the first by an American woman in nearly 40 years. The ceremony also featured political speeches on Palestine and a notable absence by producer Scott Rudin, who won but stayed away due to past bullying claims. ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/arts/tonys-2026-recap-highlights-winners-1236616152/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/legit/awards/john-lithgow-oldest-male-acting-tony-winner-giant-1236768997/))
- **China’s AIGC film push accelerates**: Multiple outlets report the launch of the Tonglu-Fuchun River AIGC High-Tech Film Creation Center in Zhejiang, a state-backed initiative aiming to reshape content production. This comes as Chinese studios quietly embrace AI while Cannes publicly condemns it. ([China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFB2a20temRMUWtHaFNjaU8xY3NKQWNqRzNleXl6RmZ2Q0VzWkVkaTVnR3Y5d2R2TFBWQ3l0VmJkTmhHN1JTaVhRRHF4TmJkYkR1QmZIRU1DUkwxaXNRcGpicE5oTk45VWltWmRfeGNJcy0zV01ueDZtaTV5TQ), [Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQRU5XVnNpRXdXRU1CckhJSHVrYzZUTmFPWmtSTkFha25sOXlhVTBwZmJxU1VIY2xDb3lLWGRDTDU4N3pwM2x5Z195ZnllUkRkYm5BSVRSZ1hlblpwWGZWX1Z0c1ZZUUwxTTVuTVZpM3hOMzhod2g2XzVuZ2RKcnpNSUM5NE9UT1dsc3BIUGl6MTFudlpRMzJZelo1T0pod2h3))
- **NBA star visits Chinese actor on set**: Boston Celtics star Jaylen Brown visited actor Wang Hedi on a movie set in China, sparking curiosity about their friendship and highlighting the growing sports-entertainment crossover. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOU09GdDlUdnVSTTRTVHozQmF2MVd2WWVIV3k1OXpBclRfdC1iVHdyMEdFazFTdC13TzVrNlNzRXlrZEQ4V19PbWF6ckJmS2xxMUstZ1JmOExQUXVfai1QQW9TeW9xZFZkVTZLU0VjbXNuUDQ4SERxZEtuU3RVX0RYaA))
- **K-pop reunion wave: Secret and I.O.I return**: Second-gen girl group Secret announced their first comeback in 12 years with mini-album *Secret Flavor* on June 18, while I.O.I members reunited for a variety show segment. MEOVV also set a personal sales record. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846081wpp/watch-secret-announces-comeback-date-with-teaser-for-1st-return-in-12-years), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846063wpp/meovv-achieves-their-highest-1st-week-sales-yet-with-bite-now))
- **Chinese social media hot topics**: White Deer (Bai Lu) received endorsement from 25 media outlets including Xinhua News; singer Huang Zitao publicly condemned a dentist for secretly filming him; and a viral post on "middle-class bankruptcy seven-piece set" sparked widespread discussion about economic pressures. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1teHpORGM3bE9ucUNnallVXzZ1MnNBWkRqOVB0c0hoTmMtOWFwMU4xaFVrbVZRNVl5cTdEa3NzUWNjd2NWS1lpVkhIRDdyOUlLMzhXZEZvTlJYZnRvUUpZTVBqWQ), [Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNRHd5ZV9ZbG5WMFkwTGw3NUJNMEZTT2dwT3BxczZpZklNRi1RTGMxWGpUSkxscHBOZ0pRVnZma1lob3ZTV0cyZ09iUE0tR1UzZU9CWng2YnhCZHhOSDNVdnJvOUI5bWozalZYaHRTRDlQMUFyQmk0al8zVHpPdjU5WlpiU3gzUF9Y), [Epoch Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE56cjRwWDdmaHJkSnFpT1RQYWdMNmtqRjZEYjcwN1VWVDYyMDJEUEViS2ZTaWxaazMxMzVDSl9IRmlUVUpSXzBvSUVKN3ZELW1ieVVPMnd5cUYyd19RODFJ)
- **薛之谦's chain hotpot restaurants close after 14 years**: All locations of the singer's hotpot brand have shut down, marking the end of a celebrity-backed F&B venture. ([Epoch Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTFBvTFRzN3p3MWJ3UnI2VlRxNzhTcmxfOFNYRkItbE5IRGlOeHRXTVhqSFRoTlFOaWhEM3lJM0ctNjVIREZ2WWM0Vlg4TjFfS0FRWVlGOFVCeEw5Zk5JMjlOQUY1aFTSAWRBVV95cUxQb0xUczd6dzFid1JyNlZUcTc4U3JsXzhTWEZCLWxOSERpTnh0V01YakhUaE5RTmloRDN5STNHLTY1SERGdlljNFZYOE4xX0tBUVlZRjhVQnhMOWZOSTI5TkFGNWhU))

**Watch next**: The Tony Awards aftermath will continue to influence Broadway and streaming strategy, while China's AIGC film center's output over the next quarter could signal a major shift in global content production. K-pop fans should watch for Secret's comeback chart performance and the upcoming drama *Excitatio* teaser response. On Weibo, the "middle-class bankruptcy" discourse may deepen as economic data releases loom.

美股.zh:
**科技股抛售潮席卷亚太，中东局势与加息预期夹击美股**

美国非农数据的“余震”叠加伊朗-以色列冲突升级，导致隔夜美股科技板块承压，亚洲时段抛售加剧。标普500 ETF（VOO vs SPY）的争论虽持续，但择时比选品更重要——恐惧指标正在飙升。

- **[AI超大规模数据中心成空头新靶心](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html)**：Jim Cramer指出，“吃饭的嘴太多，食物不够”，短期内AI基础设施投资回报存疑。
- **[博通领跌，亚洲科技跟风](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/softbank-samsung-tech-ai-stocks-asia-fall.html)**：SoftBank跌超7%，三星电子同步走低，资金正从高估值科技股撤出。
- **[油价暴涨+建材短缺或推高电子通胀](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/inflation-iran-war-consumer-economy-electronics.html)**：树脂短缺已影响电子元件生产，消费者很快会感受到物价粘性。

**判断**：市场正在重新定价“经济软着陆”叙事，若油价持续上行，美联储降息预期或将彻底逆转，美股科技股中期调整风险扩大。
美股.en:
US markets face a triple whammy: Middle East conflict driving oil higher, AI stock sell-off accelerating, and rising rate expectations. The Federal Reserve's new chairman Kevin Warsh has taken office, and enforcement actions signal continued regulatory scrutiny. Key developments include:

- **Oil spikes 3% after Iran-Israel strikes; Kospi plunges 8%.** [CNBC oil](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/oil-prices-today-us-iran-missile-middle-east-israel-opec.html), [CNBC Korea](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/kospi-sk-hynix-samsung-electronics-why-foreign-investors-are-selling.html)
- **Asia tech sell-off extends; SoftBank down 7%, Broadcom-led losses.** [CNBC Asia tech](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/softbank-samsung-tech-ai-stocks-asia-fall.html), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c78yd5g9qx0o)
- **Hyperscalers now epicenter of bear case; Cramer warns of too many mouths.** [CNBC Cramer](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html)
- **Trump storms out of interview over DOJ fund; political uncertainty.** [CNBC Trump](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/trump-election-fraud-doj-fund-weaponization-storms-out.html)
- **Kevin Warsh sworn in as Fed chair; FOMC unanimously selects him.** [Fed release](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/other20260522a.htm)

With oil volatility and AI valuation concerns colliding, the path for US equities hinges on this week's CPI data and any de-escalation in the Middle East.

中国经济.zh:
**港股恒指跌0.7%，A股科创50重挫，但南向资金逆势净买入50亿港元**

受美国加息预期和中东地缘风险双重压制，香港恒生指数和A股科创50双双下滑，但结构性机会显现：煤炭、光纤、免税概念等板块走强。中国监管层澄清“非法对外投资”整顿不涉及强制平仓，试图安抚市场。

- **[港股AI概念回调，恒生科技跌1.6%](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356289/hong-kong-stocks-slumped-ai-rallies-asia-unwind-us-rate-increase-anxiety)**：此前领涨的AI板块遭遇获利了结，投资者担忧资本外流。
- **[中国中免涨超3%，离岛免税Q1销售增20%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxPdWJ4UkVNMTdBaHRabUpYQ0l6Y3UydkgzaktsaEJObkRYem15ZXNpZUdKM1dfdnJobE5rRDNCWWh6azBtQVdoWG1tLW1nYTRtcU05bEs4cDdBWWhKUFViWktKVjJ5dUlMaVM5dnNMd01uaW50ZFdKWVlTaWdmaGFQWEMzb2JKQlhNQzY2RHdNdThGTGdhU2N1TFR6Z1RYaVU)**：出境退税升级政策利好免税板块。
- **[A股午评：全线杀跌，原因何在？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE43SDNuQS1RakhIVWhhOHhsWDVlRkFmRnlqUjZ5RFRndi1nZTFUeVFQT1N0dHNHYWZXc21rcklDVkN5SnY0ZHNYNXVtU2E0eWc3Smh4Zkpvd1VUU1JTNVE)**：社区讨论聚焦于外围拖累与国内流动性趋紧。

**判断**：短期外部冲击主导市场，但南向资金持续加仓显示内资对港股估值仍有信心。需警惕美国CPI公布前后离岸人民币波动对中资股的传导。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets slumped as global rate fears and unwinding of AI trades hit Hong Kong and mainland stocks. However, some sectors like duty-free and coal mining showed resilience. Regulators clarified that crackdown on illegal outbound investment won't force liquidations, while mainland savers continue to seek Hong Kong deposits.

欧美.zh:
**概览：** 中东战火重燃成为欧美新闻主线——以色列与伊朗互射导弹，黎巴嫩遭二次空袭，美国特朗普政府重心转移，欧洲盟友仍力促乌克兰谈判。此外，丹麦球星埃里克森赛场昏厥引发关注，世界杯举办国美国却因签证问题招致全球不满。

- [以色列对伊朗发动打击，德黑兰、伊斯法罕传出爆炸声](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/8/iran-war-live-trump-urges-restraint-after-iranian-missile-attack-on-israel?traffic_source=rss)，伊朗还击，停火协议濒临崩溃。
- 卫星图像详尽展示[美以战争对伊朗海军港口及美军基地的破坏](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/6/8/satellite-images-show-destruction-of-the-us-israel-war-on-iran?traffic_source=rss)，暴露冲突烈度。
- 泽连斯基最密切的欧洲盟友列出[五项和平谈判条件](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7xr1g3nvvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，但特朗普焦点转向伊朗，乌克兰被边缘化风险上升。
- 克里斯蒂安·埃里克森在丹麦热身赛中[突然倒地，目前已恢复意识](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/czrxgd2nljno?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，心脏问题再度引发体育界担忧。
- 全球球迷抱怨美国旅行禁令让[世界杯成为“他们的而非我们的”](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx212p8r28eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，彰显美国国际形象裂痕。

**收束：** 本周欧美头条完全被中东主导，跨国联动效应明显——从能源市场到体育外交，冲突的外溢正重塑2026年下半年的全球议程。
欧美.en:
The 欧美 desk is dominated by the rapidly escalating conflict between Israel and Iran, with multiple outlets reporting retaliatory strikes that risk a full-scale regional war. Satellite images reveal extensive destruction at military sites, while the US-Israel campaign also extends to Lebanon after a brief truce. European allies of Ukraine are trying to reframe peace conditions as US attention pivots to Iran, and the World Cup faces backlash over US travel restrictions.

- **Iran-Israel exchange of fire**: Iran launched a missile at Israel for the first time since April's ceasefire, prompting Israeli strikes on Tehran and Isfahan. The Al Jazeera liveblog provides minute-by-minute updates ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/8/iran-war-live-trump-urges-restraint-after-iranian-missile-attack-on-israel?traffic_source=rss)). NPR reports that the attacks threaten to drag the region back into war ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/08/g-s1-126844/iran-war-updates)).
- **Satellite evidence of destruction**: Al Jazeera shows 15 sites before and after the US-Israel war on Iran, including Iranian naval ports and US bases across the Gulf ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/6/8/satellite-images-show-destruction-of-the-us-israel-war-on-iran?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Lebanon drawn back in**: Israel struck Beirut's suburbs in retaliation for Hezbollah drone attacks, just days after a US-brokered truce ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0qyevk8139o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/07/nx-s1-5849220/israel-lebanon-beirut-airstrike-ceasefire)).
- **Zelensky's European allies set peace conditions**: Five conditions for talks with Russia were outlined as Trump's focus shifts to Iran ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7xr1g3nvvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **World Cup access controversy**: Fans globally complain that US travel bans and visa restrictions make them feel excluded ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx212p8r28eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).

The coming hours will determine whether the Iran-Israel exchange remains limited or escalates further—critical for oil prices and global risk appetite.

- 日韩举行[八年来首次联合搜救演习](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1GRkdvRUdWSlhpMFVEcWktb3lPRHZjaHhzbjc3cndadUtLT0Q0cUFvTFZlTGlZVkhfY2hSUzBveEEwMG5wbHhpSE14bXBuNlUyOEw5azhMaS16SVHSAVdBVV95cUxPSGs3ckhxUmJtSHBYS3FUTkJ4R0g0c0p5SlNJUFhIMEpvRHlacjVuLURRUUM0QXpwSm9CeDZjdEZFUHFTUG9FZnp1TUZNNHVRRkJfVnNKYUU)，合作信号与海鲜禁令谈判并行。
- 韩国地方选举因[选票短缺引发大规模抗议](https://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20260607062542)，年轻人要求重选，李洛渊道歉并承诺彻查。

**收束：** 日韩在安全与经济上呈现“矛盾共生”——地缘风险拖累股市，但军工与AI为韩国打开新窗口；历史问题与选举风波则提醒国内治理压力未消。
日韩.en:
